verdicts.reason: A drops the product can entirely; only a stray orange speck remains. Its legal copy is crammed into the decorative circle at an unreadable size and crowds the Shop Sale button, and WEEKEND ONLY ends up below its own headline. B keeps the can, a clear headline > subcopy > CTA order and grouped legal text, but the legal line is tiny and the button sits almost flush against the right edge on top of the circle.

A puts the tiny four-line legal block at the far left as the first thing the eye reads, a ragged fragment that breaks reading order, though its CTA has a proper right margin. B groups the legal text with WEEKEND ONLY under the copy, which reads more logically, but the legal text is very small and the Shop Sale button is jammed against the right edge.
